documents.notes: University-wide 'How to apply', 'Personal statement' and 'Your reference' pages. The how-to-apply page's UCAS deadline (14 January 2026) is for the previous cycle; the document requirements state no year. No Computer Science course page was readable at a guessed URL, so no admissions test is drafted.

items.quote: You can apply for undergraduate courses through Universities and Colleges Admissions Service (UCAS).
All applicants applying to an undergraduate course via UCAS at University of Warwick will need to write a personal statement to submit with their application.
All applicants applying to an undergraduate course via UCAS at the University of Warwick will need to submit a reference as part of their UCAS application.
